Package dev.px.core.config

Class ToggleableSection<T extends Toggleable>

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.config.ToggleableSection<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigSection
public final class ToggleableSection<T extends Toggleable> extends Object implements ConfigSection
A config section backed by a registry of Toggleables: modules, HUD elements, anything with an on/off state and settings.

Entries are keyed by name rather than by index, so adding, removing or reordering registrations cannot shift a saved config onto the wrong entry. An entry in the file that no longer exists is ignored, and one that exists but is absent from the file keeps its defaults, so configs survive version changes in both directions.

Enabled state is applied through setEnabled, which fires the lifecycle hooks, while setting values are applied silently. That ordering matters: settings are restored first, so a module's onEnable sees the configuration it is meant to start with.
